decision.explanation: Different. Ranking only the supplied references by gain-centered Welch query distance gives C03 (3.916 dB), C01 (6.081 dB), then C02 (6.235 dB). The nearest reference, C03, exceeds its calibrated 3.228 dB threshold, so the rule requires rejection rather than assignment. Figures and measurements support that decision: Q01 is dominated by a persistent approximately 15.98–16.04 kHz cluster and has 81.60% of power above 8 kHz, whereas C03 is dominated by 5.3 Hz and has 94.13% below 100 Hz. All reports share 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, and identical FFT/Welch resolution, so this discrepancy is not attributable to coverage or resolution; absolute FS amplitudes remain secondary because acquisition gain is unknown.
